rows.name: A crate's `impl Trait` values
rows.note: A view's values live past the call in a kept region (#1217). An opaque iterator that borrows its text lives beside the string (#1966). A fn item or closure coerces to a crate trait's object (#1981). Left: an opaque output that captures &self (#1991), a borrowing opaque value with another core-trait bound (#1968), markdown's impl Widget return in a Viewer impl (#83).

rows.name: Closures cross as Rust passes them
rows.note: A script closure kept or called by native code. Left: a closure called from a native value's &self method (#241, #1434), one slot per call shape (#877), a single Fn parameter (#394).

rows.name: Borrows cross as Rust lends them
rows.note: A crate value lent to a call ends where rustc ends the borrow. Left: borrows held past their last use (#596, #832, #833), lent fields in place (#830), lifetimed arguments (#68, #69).

rows.name: 'static data crosses in place
rows.note: Statics, consts and 'static text reach native code once. Left: slice literals pinned per call (#1438), a static's field or element (#1439, #1444), native consts of references (#1478).

rows.name: Generic crate items as rustc checks them
rows.note: Instances, bounds and impl selection on crate generics. Left: bounds unchecked when rawr fills a parameter (#266, #286), receiver arguments by the impl's names (#348), slices of crate types (#852).

rows.name: A program's trait impls reach native code
rows.note: A crate sees a program type's Debug, Default, Eq, Hash and its own traits. Left: hand-written Debug (#343, #1169), derive(Default) of crate fields (#619), Copy, Hash and Ord on proxies (#249).

rows.name: Every crate type is nameable
rows.note: The runner names a type however the program reached it. Left: types of a crate the project doesn't depend on (#86), local path crates (#499), sysroot types (#708).

rows.name: Async code crosses as Rust runs it
rows.note: Futures, streams and async fns across the boundary. Left: a lifetimed struct into an async fn (#689), a native future where a program expects one (#730).

Left: guards in a Result (#1924), std enum coverage (#1925), try_send (#1926), call-argument E0308 notes (#1919), lints through locals (#1920), move suggestions (#1921), macro calls in item, type and pattern positions (#961).

rows.name: Real app shapes: a library and a thin main
rows.note: inboard (about 1,070 crates) checks and runs with theme.rs, home.rs and sidebar.rs marked. Its speed is on the Bind, install, Build, Boot and Save rows. Left: native code can't call a marked fn that takes impl Fn or a named generic (#1539). A native root can't name a marked module's types (#1249).

rows.name: Bind: only what marked code names
rows.note: A cold check of inboard takes 205 s. It extracts only what marked code names (#1663, #1665). It classifies across cores (#1669). It canonicalizes across cores (#1687). Left: a grown table asks the compiler again for units it holds (#1683). Canonicalization's join and finish run on one core (#1702).

rows.name: Check after an install
rows.note: A check right after a rawr install takes 16 s on inboard. It binds no harness, resolves nothing, builds no nightly and copies nothing (#1690, #1695, #1696). It took about 7 min before. Left: an install that changes the driver still binds a harness and copies inboard's own bundle (#1701).

rows.name: Build: the runner on every core
rows.note: The runner is a workspace of a base crate and one adapter crate per imported root (#1670). A native rebuild for a one-crate edit takes 177 s where cargo build takes 18-27 s (#1772). Left: the copy's speed (#1801), a harness per preparation (#1794), re-encoding per hit (#1851).

rows.name: The runner builds each crate once
rows.note: The runner shares the project's units. Left: path crates the mirror copies (#292, #855), an absolute path dependency (#622), CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR through a link (#291).

rows.name: One lock order, no process globals
rows.note: A save takes its locks in one order and keeps its state off process statics. #1824, #1825, #1826, #1827, #1828

rows.name: Boot: a warm start compiles nothing
rows.note: A warm start reaches inboard's first app log in about 10.5 s (resolving 2.8 s, reading the API 4.8 s). A start with no edits compiles no marked file (#1638). Left: a warm start still resolves the whole program and compiles the whole generated text (#1662).

rows.name: Save: re-lower only what changed
rows.note: On inboard (0.3.213, scripted, no model in the loop): a body edit is on screen in 0.98 s, and a field change to a type native code holds restarts with no native build and settles in 2.5-2.9 s (#1755, #1865). A doc comment, an inert attribute, a blank line or a reflowed signature lowers nothing.

rows.name: Borrows and drops run as rustc's
rows.note: Code rustc accepts runs, with Rust's order of evaluation and drops. Left: rebinding a &mut local (#121, #122, #124), slice-pattern rests (#163), a closure changing self's field (#189).

rows.name: The checker reports what cargo check reports
rows.note: Cases rawr leaves to the background cargo check today. Left: self in a method body (#171), closures that return borrows (#148), lifetimes written in bodies (#129), trait-object calls (#132).

rows.name: No copy stands in for a borrow
rows.note: A borrow or move of a native or guarded value copies nothing. Left: loops and sorts over a Vec (#258), guard places (#165), field reads (#650), slices of tuples (#229).

rows.name: std as rustc has it
rows.note: std's types and methods from std's own declarations. Left: env::var (#645), fs beyond whole files (#646), Path as its own type (#679), the hand list of std types (#765), Any (#1284).

rows.name: Paths, imports and modules as rustc resolves them
rows.note: Left: traits keyed by their last segment (#758), std prefixes accepted without a use (#808), body-level uses hoisted to the module (#1052), pub use globs (#1349).

rows.name: Inference and trait selection as rustc's
rows.note: Left: <T>::f paths (#378), program iterators as I: Iterator (#380), annotations that fix a generic (#1419), expected types into arms (#1293), impls keyed by full Self (#1178).

rows.name: Patterns and exhaustiveness as rustc's
rows.note: Left: integer ranges inside variants and tuples (#1287, #1306), struct parameter patterns (#1307), an empty match on an uninhabited type (#620).

rows.name: Errors as rustc prints them

rows.name: Macros and attributes as rustc expands them
